description_en: Enables the one-click configuration of anti-ransomware backup policies for servers in the managed anti-ransomware service. You can call this operation only after you purchase the managed anti-ransomware service
description_zh: 开启防勒索托管服务一键配置防勒索服务器备份策略。仅支持购买防勒索托管服务后调用
name: OpenBackupAutoConfig

parameters.help_en:
The number of servers included in a single batch for the policy automatically generated by the managed anti-ransomware service.

The maximum value is 50. If the specified value exceeds 50, the value 50 is used
parameters.help_zh:
防勒索托管服务自动生成策略一个批次中包含的服务器数量。

最大为50，超过50以50为准
parameters.name: max_batch_size

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
